text: NVIDIA released new open models at GTC Berlin, available on Hugging Face. They include Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for text and images, Nemotron Retriever for search and document parsing, and Kumo for business data predictions. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt is due Oct 23.
